role: Gate: replays the oracle's lightning2 scene (six bolts at six strike scenes: empty, pig to pigman, villager to witch, creeper to charged, item, player) through csrc/engine/lightning.c and serverreplay.c for 30 ticks and compares bolt state, fire cells, target health, fire, pigman NBT and the end Det state.
gpu: line 64, function add_ent: realloc growth of the entity list (harness only)
notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/lightning. Native calls: lightning_constructor_fire, lightning_adopt, lightning_tick with serverreplay_lightning_strike as the strike callback, animal_construct, villager_construct, creeper_construct, player_construct, living_init, living_nbt_text, ie_adopt_item, an_add_living, det_*. Loads chunks 90..116 x 90..110 by fixed bounds. Skips (returns 0) when the manifest kind is not lightning2; honours difficulty and fire_off. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/LightningProbe.java. Recordings: out/java/lightning/light2, light2-easy, light2-no-fire, light42. Villager/pig class paths assumed at oracle/src/entity/passive; the checker verifies they exist.
